sejarah.title: History of Faculty of Engineering
sejarah.p1: The Faculty of Engineering was established in 1981 in conjunction with the founding of the six faculties comprising Universitas Wijaya Kusuma Surabaya, initially offering a single study program: Civil Engineering (TS). In its nascent years, the program comprised two specializations, namely construction engineering and hydrotechnical engineering. Following the implementation of the national curriculum in 1996/1997, it evolved into the General Civil Engineering Study Program aligned with national educational standards.
sejarah.p2: During its formative period, nearly all leadership figures and academic staff originated from the Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS) Surabaya and governmental agencies within the East Java Provincial Administration. For nearly two decades, the Faculty of Engineering was nurtured under the mentorship of ITS and relevant public institutions.
sejarah.p3: In 2007, the Software Engineering Study Program (TPL) was established under the permit of the Directorate General of Higher Education (DIKTI) No. 144/D/T/2007 on January 25, 2007, which is currently known as the Informatics Study Program (IF). Simultaneously, the Faculty of Engineering was entrusted by the university to oversee the Agro-industrial Technology Study Program (TIP), which had previously been managed by the Faculty of Agriculture since 1994. This organizational transition was driven by the rationale that the TIP curriculum is primarily oriented toward industrial technology, thereby aligning seamlessly with the governance of the Faculty of Engineering.
sejarah.timeline1981Desc: Official establishment alongside the University, pioneering higher education with Civil Engineering.
sejarah.timeline2007Desc: Inauguration of the Software Engineering Program (now Informatics), expanding digital frontiers.
sejarah.timelineNowDesc: Continuously advancing excellence across Civil Engineering, Informatics, and Agro-industrial Technology.

visiMisi.title: Vision, Mission & Objectives
visiMisi.visiQuote: "To become a distinguished Faculty of Engineering that is digitally adaptive, excellent in higher education tridharma, environmentally conscious, and professionally ethical by 2030"
visiMisi.misi1: Establish agile, transparent, and information technology-driven faculty governance that upholds good governance practices.
visiMisi.misi2: Deliver digital-based engineering education integrated with Industry 4.0 competencies and student-centered innovative learning.
visiMisi.misi3: Foster collaborative research oriented toward impactful technological solutions and appropriate innovative products.
visiMisi.misi4: Expand digital technology-based community service to strengthen local community empowerment and societal well-being.
visiMisi.misi5: Cultivate human resources who are not only professional and ethical, but also digitally literate and environmentally-oriented entrepreneurs.
visiMisi.tujuan1: Realize a premier Faculty of Engineering that is digitally empowered and responsive to global technological transformations.
visiMisi.tujuan2: Elevate tridharma quality through the strategic synergy of digitalization, collaboration, and cross-disciplinary innovation.
visiMisi.tujuan3: Develop faculty members and academic staff who are digitally proficient, creative, and productive in engineering innovations.
visiMisi.tujuan4: Produce engineering graduates who are ethical, competent, technologically adept, entrepreneurial, and prepared for dynamic global careers.

pedoman.title: Academic Handbook
pedoman.narasi1: The Academic Handbook of the Faculty of Engineering, Universitas Wijaya Kusuma Surabaya, is the official reference document governing academic administration and educational processes across the faculty. This handbook is compiled to provide clear, structured guidance for students, faculty members, and academic personnel in conducting educational, scientific research, and community engagement activities. Through this publication, the entire academic community is expected to adhere to established guidelines, fostering a structured, efficient, and sustainable educational environment that advances academic excellence and global competitiveness.
